typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT T.CallListFile,T.PhoneNumber,CASE WHEN DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_WRONG_PHN_NBR_IND = 0 OR DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_WRONG_PHN_NBR_IND IS NULL THEN \'DNC\' WHEN DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_WRONG_PHN_NBR_IND = 1 AND (DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_RND_IND = 0 OR DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_RND_IND IS NULL) THEN \'Wrong Number\' WHEN DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_WRONG_PHN_NBR_IND = 1 AND DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_RND_IND = 1 THEN \'RND\' ELSE \'UNK\' END AS DNCStatus  FROM ##tmpPhoneNumbers T 	INNER JOIN PDS_DONOTCALLPHONE DNC ON T.PhoneNumber = DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_PHONENUMBER 		AND DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_ACTIVE_IND = 1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		CallListFile as string,
		DNCStatus as string,
		PhoneNumber as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CallListFile,
		DNCStatus,
		PhoneNumber)) ~> FlatFileDestination
